config.text:
Acid rain pounded the pavement, reflecting the bright neon scattered across the grimy streets of Nexus City.
A sprawling metropolis where the rich rose in glass towers, while the poor sank into undergrounds littered with digital debris.
Zero, a newcomer to the city, stared at the metallic horizon, his cybernetic eyes capturing every detail.
He had no past, no story. All he wanted was to make a name for himself.
In a world where reputation was the most valuable currency, Zero knew he would only have one chance to climb the ranks.

Armed with only his hacking skills and implants, he vowed to conquer the city.
In the shadows of megacorporations and gangs, there were secrets to steal, alliances to break, and systems to topple.
In Nexus City, everything could be controlled, everything could be manipulated—even destiny.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: Who are you? I don't usually talk to strangers.

chat.name: zero
chat.text: Zero. I'm new in town, but I'm looking for work. I heard you might have some jobs.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: Zero, huh? I've seen guys like you. Little smart-asses who show up thinking they'll make a name overnight. Most end up in an alley, face against the concrete, without even knowing what hit them.

chat.name: zero
chat.text: I'm not like them. If you give me a job, I'll prove my worth.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: That's what you want, huh? A job. But I'm not the type to hand work to the first person who shows up. You could be working for my enemies or worse... for corpos. Maybe you're a cop.

chat.name: zero
chat.text: If I were a cop, do you really think I'd show up here, in the open? I just want creds, and I'm ready to work.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: Yeah, that's what they all say. Well... let's suppose you're clean. I might have something for you. A small job. Nothing big, but if you do well, we can talk about more.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: A company called ChromePulse. They make cheap implants for those who can't afford Militech or Arasaka. Nothing huge, but there’s a market for their stuff. Their latest toy is an auditory implant. Go there, grab the plans, and gather some info about their clients.

chat.name: zero
chat.text: That's it? No heavy security systems?

chat.name: vex
chat.text: What did you expect? A red carpet? It's not a corpo job, kid. There'll be underpaid mercs and a couple of drones watching the place. Don’t make noise, get the data, and get out before they notice anything.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: We'll see. If you screw up, you won’t need to come back. But if you succeed... maybe we can talk business again. But believe me, the next jobs won’t be as easy.

chat.name: zero
chat.text: I didn’t come for easy jobs.

chat.name: vex
chat.text: Alright, you’ve got guts, I’ll give you that. But Nexus has a habit of crushing the heads of those who think they're invincible. Good luck, Zero. You’ll need it.

config.text:
The ChromePulse building looks modest from the outside, but it's the kind of place that hides unexpected traps.
The first step is simple: cut the alarms. Everything must stay under the radar.
The alarms are silent, but a camera spotted you. Guards are approaching. You have a few seconds to disable the camera and hide!
You're almost there! Just a few more clicks and these plans are yours. But ChromePulse's servers are better protected than expected. If you want to leave alive with the data, you better stay focused.
Mission accomplished, but it wasn’t as clean as expected. Now that you have the plans, ChromePulse will investigate. You should lay low for a while, in case they decide to counterattack.
